_comment: Snippet de scripts npm pra dockerization. Cole dentro do objeto `scripts` do seu package.json. Requer `dotenv-cli` em devDependencies.

scripts.docker:up: dotenv -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.platform.yml -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.docker:pull: dotenv -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.platform.yml -f infra/docker-compose.yml pull
scripts.docker:down: dotenv -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.platform.yml -f infra/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.docker:ps: dotenv -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.platform.yml -f infra/docker-compose.yml ps
scripts.docker:logs: dotenv -- docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.platform.yml -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f
